body: - Fixed starting up error message. https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote-App/issues/1370
- Support Multiple windows (`Cmd + Shift + N` on macOS, `Ctrl + Shift + N` on Windows and Linux)

- Added in-app search. (macOS : `Cmd + F` / Windows and Linux : `Ctrl + F`)
- Added zoom controls to menu with shortcuts. (View -> Zoom In, Zoom Out, Actual Size)
   - Zoom In (macOS : `Cmd + +` / Windows and Linux : `Ctrl + +`)
   - Zoom Out (macOS : `Cmd + -` / Windows and Linux : `Ctrl + -`)
   - Actual Size (macOS : `Cmd + 0` / Windows and Linux : `Ctrl + 0`)

- Fixed preferences/new document keyboard shortcuts
- Fixed app crash when opening team switch dropdown menu after creating a doc from the desktop app.

- Fixed stability issue after removing deprecated local spaces
- Removed create local space button in sign in page
- Removed create local space menu item

- Separated local space feature from BoostNote.next (to continue using local space, please download BoostNote.next-local https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote.next-local/releases)
- Fixed app crash after idling.
- Fixed restarting behavior of app updater on macOS.
- Changed app icon for macOS to follow Apple's design guideline.
- Fixed rendering performance issue

- Improved app stability
- Improved navigator UI

- Improved the local space UI
- Fixed the space switch button
- Implemented app notifications

- Revamped UI of Local Space
- Added Drag and drop behaviors to move notes and folders in the side navigator
- Added Keymap customization

v0.17.1

- Fixed the broken markdown previewer.

v0.17.0

- Added in-note search for local spaces.
- Added keymap configuration for local spaces.
- Added bulk note exporting (exporting all notes in a specific folder).

- Introduce an 1-month trial coupon for users migrating their data from a local space.
- Roll back create local space button.
- Discard the deprecated legacy cloud storage integration
- Fixed title editing issue in cloud space

- Fix app initialization
- Fix svg attachments
- Improve PDF/HTML exporting behavior
- Fix draggable area of window when cloud space is open

- Deprecated legacy cloud storage (please check [this announcement](https://intercom.help/boostnote-for-teams/en/articles/5018959-deprecation-notice-of-the-legacy-cloud-storage))
- Discarded Note app layout
- Added migration from local space to a cloud space
- Fixed mime type handling of code fences https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote.next/pull/777

- Fix cloud space icon image in app nav
- Fix session registration from legacy session token

- Migrate cloud space source code to BoostNote.next
- Improve UI style
- Add tag color setting
- Fix renaming folders
- Fix copy button of plain snippets without language
- Fix attachment display in exported pdf files
- Fix image resizing(Allowing attributes for `<img/>` tags)
- Improve UI styling

- Implement more shortcuts Behavior | macOS | Windows/Linux --------|------|---- Switch Workspace | Cmd + 0~9 | Ctrl + 0~9 Bold | Cmd + B | Ctrl + B Italic | Cmd + I | Ctrl + I > # Other previous changes in v0.12.x > > - Improve global search modal > - Notarize macOS app > - Revamp shortcut keys > > ## Improved global search modal > > - Highlight searched string > - Show multiple search results of a note > - Show preview of searched notes > > > > # Revamp global shortcuts > > Now the below shortcuts are available for local workspaces and cloud workspaces. > > Behavior | macOS | Windows/Linux > --------|------|---- > New Note | Cmd + N | Ctrl + N > New Folder | Cmd + Shift + N | Ctrl + Shift + N > Find All Notes | Cmd + Shift + F | Ctrl + Shift + F > Find in a doc | Cmd+F | Ctrl+F > Find globally | Cmd+P | Ctrl+P > Full screen | Cmd + Ctrl+F | F11 > Toggle Edit/Preview Mode | Cmd + E | Ctrl + E > Toggle Split Editor mode | Cmd + \ | Ctrl + \ > Close Window | Cmd + W | Ctrl + W > Export a doc as a file | Cmd+S | Ctrl+S > Toggle Side Nav (Not available for local workspaces yet)| Cmd + Shift + 0 | Ctrl + Shift + 0 > Focus main content | Cmd + J | Ctrl + J > Focus Note Title | Cmd + Shift+ J | Ctrl + Shift + J

- Improve global search modal - Notarize macOS app - Revamp shortcut keys # Improved global search modal - Highlight searched string - Show multiple search results of a note - Show preview of searched notes # Revamp global shortcuts Now the below shortcuts are available for local workspaces and cloud workspaces. Behavior | macOS | Windows/Linux --------|------|---- New Note | Cmd + N | Ctrl + N New Folder | Cmd + Shift + N | Ctrl + Shift + N Find All Notes | Cmd + Shift + F | Ctrl + Shift + F Find in a doc | Cmd+F | Ctrl+F Find globally | Cmd+P | Ctrl+P Full screen | Cmd + Ctrl+F | F11 Toggle Edit/Preview Mode | Cmd + E | Ctrl + E Toggle Split Editor mode | Cmd + \ | Ctrl + \ Close Window | Cmd + W | Ctrl + W Export a doc as a file | Cmd+S | Ctrl+S Toggle Side Nav (Not available for local workspaces yet)| Cmd + Shift + 0 | Ctrl + Shift + 0 Focus main content | Cmd + J | Ctrl + J Focus Note Title | Cmd + Shift+ J | Ctrl + Shift + J

- Improve Workspace creating UI
- Fix pdf and html exporting with attachments https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote.next/pull/716
- Display code fences with invalid language types https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote.next/pull/718
- Implement copy attachment name option in attachments page https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote.next/pull/715
- Migrate creation date and updated date of legacy notes https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote.next/pull/706

Thank @Komediruzecki @guneskaan @coderkk 😍😍😍

- Improve Side navigator UI

  - Fix storage name text overflow style.
